Read docs/TASK_PHASE17.md sections 1, 2 and 7 FIRST. The contract of your file is below, verbatim from contour.yaml.

### Function Style Page

dashboard/src/style.css (phase 17), imported by main.ts and bundled by Vite into dist/assets/*.css: the look of the page. Plain CSS, no preprocessor, no external resource (no @import, no url(), no web font). It styles the elements main.ts and the renderers already make, by their ids, classes and data-* attributes; it adds no DOM.

Behavior: A calm, dense dark theme for a page left open on a second monitor all night, read at a glance from across the room: is the listener alive (the health strip), did anything happen and what (the event feed, the largest panel), and the context (summary, impl clusters). Colours are custom properties on :root with exactly these values (the dataviz reference palette, dark mode, validated 2026-10-02): --page #0d0d0d, --surface #1a1a19, --ink #ffffff, --ink-2 #c3c2b7, --muted #898781, --grid #2c2c2a, --link #6ea8ec; status --live #0ca30c, --behind #fab219, --stalled #d03b3b, --unknown #898781; origins --o-created #3987e5, --o-seen #d95926, --o-impl #199e70, --o-fetched #c98500, --o-unknown #6b6a65; kinds --k-alert #ec835a, --k-upgrade #9085e9. Body text --ink-2 on panels of --surface over a --page background, font system-ui, numbers (time, block, score, counts, members) with font-variant-numeric tabular-nums. Layout (CSS grid on #app.dash): #health is a full-width strip on top; below it #events on the left takes the larger column, and #summary above #clusters on the right; the page never scrolls sideways, also at 1024 px. Health strip: [data-field="status"] is a pill whose background is the status colour of its data-status (live, behind, stalled, unknown) with text that keeps 4.5:1 on it, at least 24 px; progress at least 20 px; the fields carry their labels as ::before text ("block", "at", "age"). Feed: every row [data-id] and the .feed-head are grids with one shared column template for ALERT rows (kind, time, block, label, score, origin, address), so the columns line up under the head and cells never overlap; UPGRADE rows may use their own template; a row with the hidden attribute has no box (the grid display must not override [hidden]); cells do not wrap (a long label is cut with an ellipsis), so rows are at most 28 px high; the kind badge is coloured by its kind, the origin badge carries its origin colour (its background or its left border). Summary: the four counters carry ::before labels ("addresses", "codes", "seeds", "proxies resolved"); each [data-bar] is a horizontal bar at least 8 px high whose segments are blocks as wide as their inline width, filled with their origin colour, labelled above by ::before ("all addresses", "last 300 blocks" from the bar's own position, not as a flex item); the legend is one line of swatches in the same colours. Fields and counters never touch: at least 12 px between neighbours. Clusters: the members column is right-aligned with at least 12 px between it and the key. .unreachable is a visible band with background --stalled and text #ffffff. Links use --link.

Examples:
1. given the built page served with the four fixtures as the backend, in headless Chrome at 1400 x 900, 3 s after load; when the computed styles are read; then body background rgb(13, 13, 13); every section.panel background rgb(26, 26, 25); the text colour of each panel has at least 7:1 contrast on its background; the font family names system-ui; no stylesheet rule is an @import and no declaration holds url(
2. given the page of example 1, at 1400 x 900 and then at 1024 x 768; when the boxes of the four panels are read; then #health is above the other three and at least 95% as wide as #app; at 1400 #events is at least 55% of the viewport wide, #summary and #clusters start right of it and #summary is above #clusters; at both sizes document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth
3. given the page of example 1 (health seconds_since_progress 24); when [data-field="status"] is read, then its data-status is set to "behind", "stalled" and "unknown" in turn; then font-size at least 24 px; background rgb(12, 163, 12), rgb(250, 178, 25), rgb(208, 59, 59), rgb(137, 135, 129); in each state the text colour has at least 4.5:1 contrast on that background; [data-field="progress"] font-size at least 20 px; the ::before content of progress, progress_at and age is "block", "at" and "age"; progress, progress_at, age and status are laid out left to right with at least 12 px between one field and the next
4. given the page of example 1 (the 8 fixture events); when the cell boxes of the ALERT rows and of .feed-head are read; then every cell of .feed-head starts within 1 px of the matching cell of the row of id 8; [data-field="time"] starts at the same x (within 1 px) in all 8 rows; in the row of id 8 each cell ends before the next starts; every row is at most 28 px high; time, block and score have tabular-nums
5. given the page of example 1; when select#kind-filter is set to "UPGRADE" and changed; then every ALERT row has a zero-height box (offsetHeight 0); back to "ALL" every row is at least 14 px high
6. given the page of example 1 (summary fixture); when the bars are read; then each [data-bar] is at least 8 px high; each segment has the background of its origin (seen rgb(217, 89, 38), unknown rgb(107, 106, 101), impl rgb(25, 158, 112), created rgb(57, 135, 229), fetched rgb(201, 133, 0)); a segment's width is its percent of the bar width within 3 px; the ::before content of the two bars is "all addresses" and "last 300 blocks"; each li[data-legend] shows a swatch of its origin colour (::before background), without a list bullet, and the legend is one line at most 24 px high; the four counters sit left to right or in a grid with at least 12 px between neighbours, each with its ::before label
7. given the page of example 1 (clusters fixture); when the first table row is read; then the members cell is right-aligned with tabular-nums and its text starts at least 12 px right of the end of the key link; every a has colour rgb(110, 168, 236)
8. given the page of example 1, then the backend answers 500 {"error": "down"} to every request; when 7 s later; then #health .unreachable has a box at least 14 px high, background rgb(208, 59, 59) and colour rgb(255, 255, 255); #health [data-field="progress"] still shows 26103569

### Requirement Frontend Tree

dashboard/ is a Node project of its own (phase 16): package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json (strict, noEmit, types vite/client), vite.config.ts (the build and the vitest config: environment happy-dom, include tests/**/*.test.ts only, setupFiles tests/setup.ts, chaiConfig.truncateThreshold 200, build.sourcemap false), index.html (a div id "app" and one module script src/main.ts), src/ and tests/. No runtime dependency; the devDependencies are pinned exactly: typescript 5.9.3, vite 7.3.6, vitest 3.2.7, happy-dom 20.14.5, @types/node 22.20.5 (latest of each line on 2026-10-02; typescript 7 and vitest 5 were not taken: the guard reads the TypeScript compiler API). Every command runs inside dashboard/: `npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run && npm run build` exits 0 and dashboard/dist then holds index.html and assets/ and nothing else, no .map file. tests/setup.ts makes globalThis.fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and node:net connect throw unless a test stubs them; tests/helpers.ts is the one module of shared stubs (fixture loader, fake fetch, fake clock, synthetic events), imported explicitly. Tests read tests/fixtures/dashboard_*.json of the Python tree in place, never a copy. node_modules and dist are not committed; Node 23 / npm 11 run on the operator's machine only, the server gets the built dist/.

### Guardrail Frontend Isolation

In dashboard/src (phase 16): no explicit any; no innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML or document.write (data reaches the DOM through textContent and setAttribute only); no console; only src/main.ts names the globals fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, setInterval, setTimeout, clearInterval, clearTimeout, document, window or globalThis (api.ts calls the fetchFn it is given, render reaches the DOM through root.ownerDocument); src/format.ts and src/feed.ts import nothing; no module imports a package (relative imports only). Checked on the TypeScript syntax tree, never on the text.

## Your task

You own exactly one file: dashboard/src/style.css (now a one-line placeholder; main.ts already imports it). Plain CSS, 150 to 300 lines, written once, completely, with no alternatives and no commentary outside the file. The DOM you style is made by dashboard/src/main.ts and the four renderers in dashboard/src/render/ (all in your context: read their element types, classes and data attributes; do not change them). Write exactly these rule groups, in this order:
1. :root with every custom property of the behavior, with exactly its values.
2. html/body: margin 0, background var(--page), colour var(--ink-2), font system-ui at 13 px.
3. #app.dash: a CSS grid, #health across the top, #events in a left column of about two thirds, #summary over #clusters on the right; min-width: 0 on the panels; it must not scroll sideways at 1024 px.
4. section.panel (background var(--surface), padding, no shadow), .panel-title (small, uppercase, var(--muted)), .panel-caption (small, var(--muted)).
5. The health strip: its data box as a flex row with gap 16 px; [data-field="progress"] 24 px var(--ink); the status pill per data-status (live, behind, stalled, unknown) with dark text #0d0d0d except stalled with #ffffff, 24 px; ::before labels "block", "at", "age".
6. The feed: .feed-head and the ALERT rows share one grid-template-columns (kind, time, block, label, score, origin, address) with a column gap; UPGRADE rows their own template; cells white-space nowrap with text-overflow ellipsis; `#events [hidden] { display: none; }`; a var(--grid) hairline between rows; kind badge coloured by data-kind (--k-alert, --k-upgrade), origin badge with a left border in its origin colour; tabular-nums on time, block, score.
7. The summary: its data box as a flex row with gap 16 px for the four counters with their ::before labels; each [data-bar] display flex, height 10 px, position relative, margin-top for its label; segments display block, flex none, background by data-origin; the bar labels as absolutely positioned ::before; ul.legend as one flex line, list-style none, li::before swatches by data-legend.
8. The clusters table: cell padding, members right-aligned with tabular-nums and padding-left 16 px.
9. Links var(--link), no underline until hover; .unreachable as a band: background var(--stalled), colour #ffffff, padding.
No @import, no url(), no web font, no animation, no gradient, no shadow. The acceptance builds the page and measures it in headless Chrome against the four fixtures (Style Page examples 1-8): every failed check prints one line "Style Page exN: ...".
